item.description:
Release v5.22.2

Changes since v5.22.1

  • docs: add crash risk audit report
  • docs: add provider observer migration plan
  • feat(provider): add typed addObserver to IdleTime and PerformanceMetrics providers
  • feat(skill): let any plugin contribute skills via SkillProviding provider
  • feat(skill): load plugin-contributed skills from Resources directories
  • fix: isolate pending messages across conversations
  • fix: route Sparkle downloads through domestic CDN
  • fix(chat): keep verbosity rendering-only
